decision: Boss chose to actually enable the token posture in .env over keeping AUTH_MODE=off and rewriting the gate wording. Rationale: the promotion gate table claimed the auth form was '决定并实施', while the running configuration had neither AUTH_MODE nor COCHPIA_API_TOKEN, so the runtime did not match the claim (server/auth.js defaults to 'off').

added: COCHPIA_API_TOKEN=<64 hex chars, generated with /usr/bin/openssl rand -hex 32>
change.backup: .env.bak-20260912-auth (contains the previous .env; now ignored by the new .env.bak* gitignore rule)
change.rollback: remove the AUTH_MODE / COCHPIA_API_TOKEN block and restart, or restore .env.bak-20260912-auth

wiringVerification.method: load .env into process.env, then dynamic import server/auth.js and exercise authenticateRequest with synthetic sockets. No server boot, no pg import.
wiringVerification.validateAuthStorage('postgres'): ok - no AUTH_CONFIGURATION_INVALID (the fail-fast requires COCHPIA_API_TOKEN, which is present)

honestLimits: The app process was not running at the time. The new .env takes effect on the next start.

vite dev proxies /api to localhost:8787, so a browser on another machine loading the vite page still reaches the app as loopback and is NOT gated. Only direct :8787 and the TLS front :8443 requests are gated. This is a development-posture limitation, not a production one.

No dual-machine TLS+Bearer re-run today. The credential path itself was last exercised on 2026-09-11 (evidence/auth-token-2026-09-11.json); today's verification covers the wiring of this machine's configuration.
